name: Mu Digital AZND
oneLiner: AZND is Mu Digital's KYC-gated, NAV-bearing dollar token backed by a Singapore-regulated Asia credit fund, with a muBOND junior tranche absorbing first losses.
collateral: The last Accountable snapshot Pharos ingested showed the Asset Pool concentrated in short-term cash and liquid bonds; Mu Digital's published mandate still targets an Asia credit portfolio with illiquid private credit capped at 20%, and the muBOND junior tranche overcollateralizes AZND at ~118%
pegMechanism: KYC-gated 1:1 mint using USDC, USDT, or AUSD; redemptions processed weekly (~7 calendar days) per Singapore fund liquidity calendar; muBOND junior tranche absorbs NAV losses first; insurance fund provides additional backstop; permissionless secondary swaps via DEX partners on Monad

jurisdiction.license: Portfolio managed by Golden Hill Asset Management (GHAM) under MAS Capital Markets Services Licence CMS-101035; assets held in a regulated fund vehicle

genius.notes: AZND is a yield-bearing Asia Dollar product with mint/redeem mechanics; GENIUS treatment remains unresolved.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: AZND moves between Ethereum and Monad as a native LayerZero V2 Omnichain Fungible Token (burn-on-source / mint-on-destination), confirmed by the verified Ethereum implementation (0x2E49c14A) inheriting @layerzerolabs/oft-evm-upgradeable OFTUpgradeable whose _debit burns and _credit mints, wired to the canonical LZ V2 EndpointV2, and by a live ETH<->Monad message flow on LayerZeroScan (15+ delivered, ~24 messages/24h). It is a pure OFT, not an OFT Adapter/lockbox. The OApp runs a custom (non-default) DVN security stack on the Monad pathway (EID 30390) using named LayerZero DVNs (Deutsche Telekom, LayerZero Labs, Canary, plus Frax/Horizen), placing it in the external-validated-network tier. (Exact required/optional DVN counts and threshold were not independently byte-confirmed from getConfig.)

mintAuthority.summary: AZND is a KYC-gated, NAV-bearing fund token issued by Mu Digital against a MAS-regulated Asia credit fund; the issuer mints 1:1 on USDC/USDT/AUSD subscriptions and burns on weekly redemptions, with a muBOND junior tranche absorbing losses.

controls.label: Mu Digital fund issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: Mu Digital mints AZND against KYC-gated subscriptions (USDC/USDT/AUSD) at fund NAV and burns on weekly redemptions; secondary DEX swaps are permissionless but primary issuance is issuer-gated.

controls.label: AZND Ethereum owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295029, owner() on the AZND ERC1967 UUPS proxy (0x52c66B5E...08A0, impl 0x2e49c14a — OFT with upgradeToAndCall) returned 0x8b5f269f68d42490dee19fc4ab275cdd80940068. Confirmed via ERC-7201 Ownable storage slot and OwnershipTransferred event (block 24289119, from deployer 0xeae74c... to current owner). eth_getCode returns no bytecode → EOA. No accessManager set; no separate MINTER_ROLE in OFT impl ABI.

review.evidence: Mu Digital materials and the Accountable proof-of-reserve dashboard describe a KYC-gated NAV fund token minted by the issuer against a MAS-regulated Asia credit portfolio; no user-collateralized or permissionless mint route exists. Ethereum owner confirmed as EOA 0x8b5f...0068 at block 25295029; UUPS proxy with owner-controlled upgrade path.
unresolvedQuestions: Monad deployment (0x4917a5ec9fcb5e10f47cbb197abe6ab63be81fe8): RPC is reachable (rpc.monad.xyz, block 80,806,841) but all access-control reads fail — owner() reverts, ERC-7201 Ownable slot is zero, slot 0 is zero, no EIP-1967 proxy, no OZ AccessControl, no LZ delegate() or wards() response. Contract's access control layout is non-standard and unreadable from public RPC; Monad mint authority remains opaque.
